description: Implementation of sparse cache control logic for disk cache in Chromium, including managing child entries, range operations, and serialization of sparse data structures.

classes.name: ChildrenDeleter
classes.description: A reference-counted class responsible for deleting child entries of a sparse cache entry.

methods.name: ChildrenDeleter::OnFileIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of file I/O, initiates deletion of children.

methods.name: ChildrenDeleter::Start
methods.description: Starts the deletion process with provided buffer and length.

methods.name: ChildrenDeleter::ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from a specified address to initiate deletion.

methods.name: ChildrenDeleter::DeleteChildren
methods.description: Deletes all child entries tracked in the children map.

methods.name: GetSparseEventType
methods.description: Returns the NetLog event type for a given sparse operation.

methods.name: LogChildOperationEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of a child operation for NetLog.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::Init
methods.description: Initializes sparse control, creating or opening sparse data entry.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::CreateSparseEntry
methods.description: Creates a new sparse data entry.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::OpenSparseEntry
methods.description: Opens existing sparse data entry and reads header and bitmap.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::StartIO
methods.description: Begins a sparse I/O operation (read, write, get range).

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Returns the available address range within the sparse data.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::CancelIO
methods.description: Cancels ongoing I/O operation.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::ReadyToUse
methods.description: Prepares the sparse control for reuse after cancellation.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::DeleteChildren
methods.description: Deletes all child entries associated with the sparse entry.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::OpenChild
methods.description: Opens or continues tracking a child entry.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::CloseChild
methods.description: Saves child data and closes the child entry.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::GenerateChildKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a child entry based on signature and offset.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::KillChildAndContinue
methods.description: Deletes a child entry and continues operation.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::ContinueWithoutChild
methods.description: Handles case where child entry cannot be opened.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::ChildPresent
methods.description: Checks if a child entry exists for current offset.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::SetChildBit
methods.description: Sets or clears the bit indicating presence of a child.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::WriteSparseData
methods.description: Serializes and writes the children bitmap to disk.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::VerifyRange
methods.description: Verifies that the requested range has no holes.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::UpdateRange
methods.description: Updates the bitmap and header after a write operation.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::PartialBlockLength
methods.description: Returns the length of partial data in a block.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::InitChildData
methods.description: Initializes data for a new child entry.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::DoChildrenIO
methods.description: Performs I/O on child entries until complete.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::DoChildIO
methods.description: Performs a single child I/O operation.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::DoGetAvailableRange
methods.description: Implements get available range within a child.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::DoChildIOCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a child I/O operation.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::OnChildIOCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when child I/O completes.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::DoUserCallback
methods.description: Runs the user callback after operation completes.

methods.name: disk_cache::SparseControl::DoAbortCallbacks
methods.description: Runs callbacks for aborted operations.
